Nanking Again
Said Seeking
Court Control

Pressure Reported Being Made On Kidnaped
Judge Of First Special District Court;
Other Judges Taking Precautions

Further pressure was today reported to have been laid
by Nanking up Judge Fong Ching-wei of the criminal
branch of the First Special District Court, who was on a
'sick-leave' immediately after the abduction of his wife from
his French Concession home last month, the Evening Post
learned from Chinese sources this morning, which declared
that the Nanking regime is still seeking to take over jurisdic-
tion of the Chinese courts in the Settlement.

Usually well informed Chinese
circles pointed out that Judge
Fong was apparently in an embar-
rassing position, as he could not
continue his work in the still-
Chungking controlled First Special
District Court in the International
Settlement, following the abduc-
tion of his wife a month ago.

Deny Reports
Officers of the court, when in-
terviewed by the Evening Post
this morning, emphatically denied
the truth in the reports, although
they did not conceal their feeling
they have been carrying on their
jobs under difficulties.

Practically all senior officers of
the court have been leading a con-
fined life during the last few
months, it will be recalled. Most
judges, it was revealed, spend all
their time in court premises so
as to ensure protection.

Many Abducted
Last November, prior to the tak-
ing over of the Second Special
District Court in the French Con-
cession by Nanking, several judges
of the then Chungking controlled
courts were also abducted for ob-
vious political reasons, it will be
recalled.

Save for the successful abduc-
tions of several junior officers of
the Settlement court during the
last two months, all attempts to
carry away ruling judges of the
same court have so far failed.

Homes Bombed
In April and May, the homes of
four senior judges of the Settle-
ment court were successively
bombed by terrorists, it will be
recalled.

Nanking - sponsored Chinese
dailies have continually threatened
the taking over at the only two
remaining Settlement courts in
Shanghai, the First Special Dis-
trict Court, and its appeal court,
the Third Branch Kiangsu High
Court.

南京再次
据称寻求
控制法院

据报南京方面对第一特区地方法院被绑架法官施加压力；
其他法官采取预防措施

《晚邮报》今晨从中方消息人士处获悉，据报南京方面今日进一步对第一特区地方法院刑事庭法官冯景伟（Fong Ching-wei，音译）施加压力。冯法官在上月其妻于法租界寓所被绑架后，随即请了“病假”。消息人士称，南京政权仍试图接管租界内中国法院的管辖权。

通常消息灵通的中方人士指出，冯法官显然处于尴尬境地，因为在其妻一个月前被绑架后，他无法继续在仍由重庆方面控制的第一特区地方法院（位于公共租界内）开展工作。

否认报道

法院官员今晨在接受《晚邮报》采访时，坚决否认报道内容的真实性，尽管他们并未掩饰在困难条件下开展工作的感受。

回想起来，在过去几个月里，法院几乎所有高级官员都过着深居简出的生活。据悉，大多数法官为确保安全，将所有时间都花在法院办公场所内。

多人被绑架

回想起来，去年十一月，在南京方面接管法租界第二特区地方法院之前，当时由重庆方面控制的法院的几名法官也因明显的政治原因遭到绑架。

除了过去两个月内成功绑架了租界法院的几名低级职员外，迄今为止，所有企图带走该法院主审法官的尝试均告失败。

住宅遭轰炸

回想起来，四月和五月间，租界法院四名高级法官的住宅相继遭到恐怖分子炸弹袭击。

由南京方面资助的中文日报不断威胁要接管上海仅存的两家租界法院，即第一特区地方法院及其上诉法院——江苏高等法院第三分院。

MUNICIPAL
RE
D.

Reorganization
Of Bar Ass'n
Now Underway

No difficulty is likely to be encountered in the reorganization of the Shanghai Chinese Bar Association which is said to have already signified its approval of such a step, the Central Press Service learned today.

Following the convocation of a meeting of the various interested parties by Mr. Yen Luen-kuei, President of the Shanghai District Court, a committee for the taking over of the Chinese Bar Association was organized with Messrs. Tsao Kuen, Wang Su-chao and three other eminent lawyers as its members.

Attitude Keenly Observed

In the meantime, the attitude of the existing Bar Association is being keenly observed by the general public, but the reorganization of the Association will probably proceed without a hitch as it is understood to have already expressed its agreement in principle of the measure contemplated by the District Court.

As a matter of fact, the Association has already suspended its activities, and its premises in the French Concession have been vacated with only a coolie left to act as a watchman.

中央新闻社今日获悉，上海中国律师公会据称已表示赞同此举，因此其改组工作不太可能遇到任何困难。

继上海地方法院院长严伦奎（Yen Luen-kuei，音译）召集各方利害关系人开会后，一个接管中国律师公会的委员会得以成立，成员包括曹坤（Tsao Kuen，音译）、王述樵（Wang Su-chao，音译）及其他三位著名律师。

密切关注态度

与此同时，公众正密切关注现有律师公会的态度，但鉴于据悉该公会已在原则上对地方法院拟议的措施表示同意，公会的改组可能会顺利进行，不会出现波折。

事实上，该公会已停止活动，其在法租界的办公场所已腾空，仅留一名苦力担任看守。

Chinese-American Daily News, Cheng Yien Pao, National Herald,

CASES PENDING AT CHINESE COURTS IN FRENCH CONCESSION TO BE
TRANSFERRED TO THE COURTS IN INTERNATIONAL SETTLEMENT FOR
TRIAL

Following the seizure of the two Chinese Courts
in the French Concession, proceedings for all cases pending at
these Courts are stayed.
According to information secured yesterday by a
reporter of the Ping King News Agency (平明社) from judicial
circles, the Ministry of Justice, the Supreme Court and the
Second Branch Kiangsu High Court are devising ways and means
to remedy the situation arising out of appeals filed by the
people with the Third Branch Kiangsu High Court prior to
November 8 and of those appeals which litigants intend to
file with the High Court against judgments rendered by the
Lower Court. Lately, the judges, who have evacuated from
the Courts in the French Concession, have been holding
discussions with the authorities of the Supreme Court and
the Second Branch Kiangsu High Court, and it is likely that
concrete measures will be drawn up in the near future whereby
those cases pending at the French Concession Courts will be
heard by the Courts in the International Settlement.

LOCAL LAWYERS REFUSE TO APPLY FOR ILLEGAL REGISTRATION

According to reports secured from a certain
party, the Nanking regime is at the present time attempting
to induce the lawyers in Shanghai to apply for registration
at the Ministry of Justice of that regime, so as to organize
another bar association. As a large number of lawyers are
upright, they all refuse to attend the sessions of the

willing to abandon their legal practices and find other
work. Only a few weak-minded elements have surrendered,
but their certificates as lawyers have been withdrawn by

In compliance with this order, the Shanghai Bar Association
has been undergoing investigation into the number of
these lawyers.

ATTEMPT TO INDUCE LOCAL LAWYERS TO REGISTER WITH THE NANKING
GOVERNMENT

In order not to bring themselves into
trouble, all the members of the local Bar Association are
unwilling to attend the two Courts in the French Concession
since their seizure by a certain party, whilst most of the
residents wish to settle their differences between themselves,
knowing that any lawsuits they file with these Courts will
not be valid in future from a legal point of view. On this
account, these Courts are practically deserted.
Recently it was reported that a certain
party is deputising men to induce local lawyers to register
with the "Ministry of Justice" and to form another Bar
Association. However, according to information secured
yesterday by a reporter of the Ping Ming News Agency, the
reported attempt is bound to end in failure due to the firm
stand adopted by the local lawyers. Although it is not known
what methods the certain party is employing to induce lawyers
to appear in its Courts, no other lawyers, with the exception
of a few weak-minded legal practitioners who had already
changed their allegiance after these Courts had been taken
over, are understood to have been affected. Moreover, as
regards the disaffected lawyers, the Ministry of Justice of
the Chungking Government has already issued an order
cancelling their certificates, while the local Bar Association
has also conducted a detailed investigation for the purpose
of submitting a report.

为了避免给自己带来麻烦，自法租界两家法院被某方查封以来，本地律师公会的所有成员均不愿出席这两家法院的庭审，而大多数居民希望自行解决纠纷，因为他们知道在这些法院提起的任何诉讼在法律上将来都是无效的。因此，这些法院实际上门可罗雀。

BAR ASSOCIATION TO
BE REFORMED

Shanghai District Court
Plans Formation Of A
New Legal Body

In order to reform the Shanghai
Bar Association officials of the
Shanghai District Court were re-
ported recently to have summoned
representatives of the Association
to a meeting when plans were made
to form a new lawyers' body.

Presiding over the meeting Mr.
Kyi Lan-kwei, President of the
Shanghai District Court, told those
assembled of the necessity to have
all Chinese lawyers grouped into an
association which will protect the
interests of its members and the
prestige of the legal profession.

Messrs. Tsao Kun, Wang Suh-
chiao, Koh Feng, Chien Chang-tao
and Chang Yung of the Bar As-
sociation were present at the meet-
ing which was also attended by
members of the Social Movement
Direction Committee and officers of
the Nanking Political Police.

The five Chinese lawyers present
were asked to form a Reform Com-
mittee to bring about the change of
policy of the Association.

It will be remembered that all
Chinese lawyers, members of the
Bar Association, recently refused to
take up any cases in the Second
Special District Court in the French
Concession which had been taken
over by the Nanking Government a
few weeks ago.

One of the main features of the
meeting, it was reported, was the
anxiety expressed by the District
Court Chairman to eradicate all
difficulties existing between mem-
bers of the Bar Association and the
various Nanking Courts in the
city.

律师公会即将

上海地方法院
计划组建新的
法律团体

据报道，为了改组上海律师公会，上海地方法院官员最近召集了公会代表开会，会上制定了组建新的律师团体的计划。

上海地方法院院长季兰桂（Kyi Lan-kwei，音译）主持会议，他向与会者讲述了将所有中国律师组成一个协会的必要性的，该协会将保护其成员的利益和法律职业的声望。

律师公会的曹坤（Tsao Kun）、王述樵（Wang Suh-chiao）、葛峰（Koh Feng，音译）、钱长道（Chien Chang-tao，音译）和张勇（Chang Yung，音译）出席了会议，社会运动指导委员会成员和南京政治警察官员也出席了会议。

到场的五位中国律师被要求成立一个改革委员会，以改变公会的政策。

回想起来，所有身为律师公会成员的中国律师，最近都拒绝受理几周前被南京政府接管的法租界第二特区地方法院的任何案件。

据报道，会议的一个主要特点是，地方法院院长表达了消除律师公会成员与市内各南京法院之间现存困难的迫切愿望。

主持会议的上海地方法院院长倪伦桂（音译）发表讲话，指出改组律师公会的必要性。倪伦桂与社会运动指导委员会上海分会委员会代表朱岭南（音译）任命五名律师——曹孙（音译）、王淑乔（音译）、葛峰（音译）、钱中道（音译）和张勇（音译）——为接管委员会成员，负责准备接管本地律师公会。

据悉，接管委员会的五名成员将在数日内拜访社会部部长丁慕宗（音译），寻求其协助。

New Bar Association

Leading Chinese dailies here state
that the Nanking régime proposes to
establish another Shanghai bar asso-
ciation trying to rally Chinese
lawyers in Shanghai to its support.
It is stated, however, that most of
the lawyers registered with the
Shanghai Bar Association have re-
fused to register. Their determina-
tion is said to be so strong that
they would rather change their pro-
fession.

An order from Chungking cancell-
ing the registration of several Chi-
nese lawyers in Shanghai because
they attended hearings held in the
courts in the French Concession re-
cently taken over by the new
régime was published recently by
the Chinese press.
pages.zh:
新律师公会

此地主要中文日报称，南京政权拟建立另一个上海律师公会，试图拉拢在沪中国律师予以支持。然而，据报道，大多数在上海律师公会注册的律师拒绝重新注册。据说他们的决心非常坚定，宁愿转行也不愿注册。

中国报刊近日刊登了一项来自重庆的命令，取消几名在沪中国律师的注册资格，原因是他们近期出席了已被新政权接管的法租界法院举行的庭审。

pages.en:
Chinese Lawyers To Fight
Registration With Nanking

Considerable concern was
shown in Chinese legal circles
yesterday toward the report
emanating from Nanking that
plans had been launched in
Shanghai to obtain registration
of all lawyers practicing in local
courts with the Ministry of
Justice at Nanking.
Leading lawyers were of the
opinion that if hard pressed they
would suspend their practice in the
only tribunals which are still open
to them, the First Special District
Court and the Kiangsu High Court,
Second Branch, in the Settlement.
It was also considered like-
ly that the Chinese Bar As-
sociation, which since the
establishment of the Nanking
regime has greatly curtailed its
activities, might close down its
offices here, and that a new bar
association would come into be-
ing under the auspices of the
new regime.

Lawyers Said Loyal

Lawyers interviewed by THE
CHINA PRESS stated that in their
opinion with the exception of a
very few most Shanghai lawyers
still practicing here are loyal to the
National Government in Chungking
and that most of them would prefer
to suspend their practice here than
register with the Nanking regime.
According to an official of the
local bar association, a large number
of Shanghai lawyers has already
deserted their rank as legal prac-
titioners and joined the Wang
government. The names of these
"recalcitrant" lawyers, it was added,
have been officially dropped from
the directory of the association and
their licenses cancelled by the
Chungking Government.

According to the official, investiga-
tions are under way to determine
the status of several prominent
lawyers alleged to be silent partners
of disbarred practitioners who con-
tinued their appearance before the
Second Special District Court and
the Kiangsu High Court, Third
Branch, in the Concession.

To Report To Chungking

On completion of the investiga-
tions, it was said, reports on the
association's findings would be
made to Chungking together with
its recommendations. The investiga-
tions were said to have been
launched on complaints filed by
members that the lawyers concerned
were the "men behind the scene"
although they themselves never
appeared before the suspended
courts.
In late months, the official added,
a large number of Shanghai
lawyers in view of the uncertain ties
the local courts are facing have
given up their practice and entered
other professions, contending that
in the near future, legal practi-
tioners would either be required to
submit to the control of the Wang
regime or lose their status before
the local tribunals.
It was also pointed out that the
legal practice in Shanghai, which
before the war was a remunerative
and interesting one, had lost much
of its appeal to the men of the
law in view of the uncertain
political conditions here.
About 1,000 lawyers have been
practicing in Shanghai, most of
them also holding certificates of
public accountants certified by the
National Government.
pages.zh:
中国律师抵制向南京注册

昨日，法律界对源自南京的一则消息表示极大关注，该消息称上海已启动计划，要求所有在地方法院执业的律师向南京司法部注册。
资深律师认为，如果受到强力逼迫，他们将停止在唯一仍向他们开放的法庭——即租界内的第一特区法院和江苏高等法院第二分院——进行执业。
人们还认为，自南京政权成立以来活动大幅缩减的中国律师公会可能会关闭其在沪办事处，而在新政权的庇护下将成立一个新的律师公会。

律师声称忠诚

接受《字林西报》采访的律师表示，在他们看来，除极少数人外，大多数仍在沪执业的上海律师忠于重庆国民政府，且大多数人宁愿停止在沪执业，也不愿向南京政权注册。
据本地律师公会的一位官员称，大量上海律师已脱离法律从业者行列，加入汪伪政府。他补充说，这些“顽固”律师的名字已被正式从公会名录中除名，其执照也被重庆政府吊销。

据该官员称，目前正在进行调查，以确定几位著名律师的身份，这些人被指控是被除名从业者的幕后合伙人，而这些被除名者继续在租界的第二特区法院和江苏高等法院第三分院出庭。

向重庆报告

据说，调查结束后，公会将其调查结果及建议一并上报重庆。据悉，调查是因会员投诉而启动的，投诉称相关律师虽未亲自出现在已停摆的法院，却是“幕后操纵者”。
该官员补充说，近几个月来，鉴于地方法院面临的不确定性，大量上海律师放弃执业，转入其他行业，他们认为在不久的将来，法律从业者要么被迫服从汪伪政权的控制，要么将失去在地方法庭的地位。
他还指出，战前在上海从事法律工作曾是一项报酬丰厚且有趣的职业，但鉴于当地政治局势不明朗，其对法律人士的吸引力已大减。
约有1,000名律师在上海执业，其中大多数人还持有国民政府认证的公共会计师证书。

MAINICHI :-

UNREST IN SHANGHAI BAR ASSOCIATION

Since the Second Special District Court and the Third High Court were taken over by the Nanking Government, discussions over the question as to whether or not the members of the Shanghai Bar Association should follow the order of the Chungking Government prohibiting their attendance at the two courts have been held at several meetings of trustees of the Association and yet no definite decision has been reached.

Recently the Bar Association received from the Chungking Government an order to the effect that those lawyers who attend the above-mentioned two courts shall be arrested. However, the Sino-Japanese alliance has already been concluded and those lawyers who have realized the real trend of the times are now advocating together with pro-Wang Ching-wei lawyers that they should cut off their connections with the Chungking regime and resolutely attend the two courts for the benefit of the Chinese people.

On the other hand, a certain pro-Chungking lawyer made the following statement :-
"Of course, it is our mission to pursue our practice in courts for the benefit of the people, but I do not think that we should attend the courts even at the risk of our lives."

Thus, the Shanghai Bar Association is divided into two sides and development of friction in the Association is being watched with much concern.

上海律师公会内部动荡

自第二特区法院和第三高等法院被南京政府接管以来，律师公会理事会多次召开会议，讨论公会成员是否应遵循重庆政府禁止出席这两所法院的命令，但尚未达成明确决定。

最近，律师公会收到重庆政府的一项命令，称出席上述两所法院的律师将被逮捕。然而，中日联盟已经缔结，那些认清时代真正潮流的律师，正与亲汪精卫的律师一道，主张切断与重庆政权的联系，并为了中国人民的利益坚决出席这两所法院。

另一方面，一位亲重庆的律师发表如下声明：
“当然，我们的使命是为了人民利益在法院进行执业，但我认为我们不应冒生命危险去出席法院。”

因此，上海律师公会分裂为两派，公会内部摩擦的发展正受到密切关注。

THE LATE M. D'HOOGHE

Shanghai mourns to-day at the bier
of M. Edouard d'Hooghe de la Gauguene,
who, at the age of 68, fell before the
bullets of two unidentified assassins.
Profound tribute will be paid at the
funeral services at St. Pierre Church, but
words, no matter how feelingly expressed,
can ever hope to salve the wounds upon
human conscience that were provoked
by this outrage. In a troubled world this
city has witnessed horror, sudden death,
and the bitter tears of bereavement, but
it has steadfastly refused to become
calloused to such barbarities. The brutal
killing of an aged, revered and respected
gentleman arouses universal indignation
and revolt not only at those who pulled
the trigger but those infinitely more
guilty who conceived and planned the
dastardly act. M. Edouard d'Hooghe de
la Gauguene was not the kind of man
who had personal enemies. He served
France and his people nobly and faithfully,
in the way he knew best. Those who
thought they knew better how he should
conduct his official affairs, chose to end
that career in a blaze of gunfire. This
murder comes as a climax to a long series
of political killings and, significantly, not
one of the outrages has deterred the
forces of progress here that those who
revert to violence believed they could
retard. This city's patience with those
of primitive intellect who hold human life
and dignity in such low esteem is close
to an end. The futility of such tactics is
patent, but this lesson is never learned
by those whose concepts of patriotism
are parallel to terrorism. The sooner
that deeply-felt public indignation is
translated into concrete action, the better
it will be for Shanghai and all its
residents.

悼念奥格先生

今日，上海在爱德华·德·拉·高格内·奥格先生（M. Edouard d'Hooghe de la Gauguene）的灵柩前哀悼，这位68岁的长者倒在两名身份不明的刺客枪下。
在圣彼得教堂举行的葬礼上将致以深切的敬意，但无论言辞多么恳切，都无法抚平这一暴行在人类良知上留下的创伤。在这个动荡的世界里，这座城市目睹了恐怖、突如其来的死亡和丧亲之痛的眼泪，但它始终拒绝对这些野蛮行径变得麻木不仁。
残忍杀害一位年迈、受人爱戴和尊敬的绅士，不仅激起了人们对扣动扳机者的普遍愤怒和反抗，更激起了对那些策划和构想这一卑鄙行径、罪责更深重者的愤慨。
爱德华·德·拉·高格内·奥格先生并非那种会有个人仇敌的人。他以自己认为最好的方式，高贵而忠实地为法国及其人民服务。那些自认为更懂得他应如何处理公务的人，选择用一阵枪火终结他的职业生涯。
这次谋杀是一系列政治暗杀的高潮，值得注意的是，没有任何一次暴行吓退那些企图通过暴力阻碍进步的力量。这座城市对那些智力原始、视生命和尊严如草芥者的耐心已接近尽头。
这种策略的徒劳显而易见，但那些将爱国主义概念与恐怖主义等同的人从未吸取这一教训。公众的深切愤慨越早转化为具体行动，对上海及其所有居民就越有利。

During the last few months the late Judge
Edouard d'Hooghe de la Gauguerie led an ener-

pages.en:
Anarchy In Shanghai
IS SHANGHAI HEADING FOR ANARCHY
under guidance of the Nipponese-sponsored
New Order? Hardly an hour passes without
some news item great or small indicating that
this is the case in most literal truth.
The most shocking recent development, of
course, was the assassination of Judge Edouard
d'Hooghe de la Gauguerie, French Municipal
Council advocate. He was shot dead by two
unidentified gunmen for reasons unknown.
This was one more addition to a long list of
brutal killings including both foreigners and
Chinese, usually with some apparent political
motivation, and with only infrequent appre-
hension of the slayers. Even when the actual
assassins are caught it is always evident that
they are no more than tools for people "higher
up" somewhere.
Such means of solving political differences
are, of course, utterly reprehensible and futile.
They are condoned by no decent person.
But the spirit behind crimes of this sort
is no less apparent in a host of other events
and continuing situations with which this
community is being cursed.
We place in precisely the same lawless
category such things as the following:
Western District conduct under official
auspices of gambling, narcotics sales, and kid-
napping for ransom.
"Jammings" of Shanghai radio stations as
a means of forcing them into more docile ways,
or perhaps in an effort to get them off the air
altogether.
Barricading innocent people by the thou-
sand inside areas in which crime has been
committed—a type of pseudo-"policing" which
no professional police would countenance for
a moment.
Conduct of trade monopolies which rob
the poor Chinese farmer, boost prices to the
city consumer, and bar third-party nationals
from legitimate participation in China's com-
merce.
Such incidents as the one witnessed on
Garden Bridge yesterday when Naval Landing
Party men made a helpless Chinese ricksha
coolie grovel for 20 minutes because he had
started over the bridge armed with the thing
legally required—a Settlement license.
The foregoing could be continued inde-
finitely but we stop for lack of space and
patience. Can there be any doubt in the mind
of any civilized being that the prevailing in-
fluences in Shanghai today tend not toward
the construction of a "New Order" but rather
the destruction of both order and law?
pages.zh:
上海的无政府状态
上海是否在日本人支持的“新秩序”指导下走向无政府状态？几乎每一小时都有大大小小的新闻表明，这在字面意义上确实如此。
当然，最近最令人震惊的事态发展是法租界公董局法律顾问爱德华·德胡格·德拉戈格里法官遇刺身亡。两名身份不明的枪手出于未知原因将其枪杀。
这又为一系列残酷杀戮事件增添了一例，受害者包括外国人和中国人，通常带有某种明显的政治动机，而凶手却很少被抓获。即使真正的刺客被捕，也总是显而易见，他们不过是某处“更高层”人物的工具。
这种解决政治分歧的手段当然是完全应受谴责且徒劳的。任何正派人都不会宽恕这种行为。
但是，这类犯罪背后的精神同样明显地体现在诅咒着这个社区的许多其他事件和持续局势中。
我们将以下事项归入同样的无法无天之列：
在官方庇护下，西区进行的赌博、毒品销售和绑架勒赎活动。
干扰上海广播电台，以此迫使它们变得更加顺从，或者可能是为了让他们彻底停播。
将成千上万无辜的人封锁在发生犯罪的区域内——这是一种伪“警务”行为，任何专业警察都不会容忍片刻。
实施贸易垄断，掠夺贫穷的中国农民，抬高城市消费者的价格，并阻止第三国国民合法参与中国的商业活动。
诸如昨天在外白渡桥目睹的事件，海军陆战队士兵让一名无助的中国黄包车夫匍匐在地长达20分钟，仅仅因为他携带了法律要求的物品——工部局执照——过桥。
上述事例可以无限列举下去，但由于篇幅和耐心有限，我们在此打住。任何文明人心中难道还会有任何怀疑吗？当今上海的主流势力倾向的不是建设“新秩序”，而是破坏秩序和法律？

pages.en:
French Here Mourn
D'Hooghe Shooting

Two Gunmen Slay Well-Known Official At Steps
Of Home; Unknown Assassins Fire
At Judge From Point-Blank Range

A solemn air of tragedy today prevailed among the local French community following the brutal assassination of Judge Edouard d'Hooghe de la Gauguerie, 64-years-old French Municipal Council Advocate, almost on the doorstep of his home at 24 Route de Boissezon yesterday evening, when two unknown gunmen fired four shots at the aged and well-known French official with mortal effect.

The French Concession police were rushing investigations in the case this morning, as it is strongly believed that a political motive is linked to the slaying. The identity of the gunmen, however, was not ascertained this morning, although both were briefly described to have been dressed in Chinese clothes.

No Family
Judge d'Hooghe, who was among one of the most popular and well-known French residents here, left no immediate family, it was learned today, since he had been married twice before, but both wives dying before him. He did not have any children.

Details regarding funeral arrangements for the late official were being planned this morning, and it is expected that the French authorities will announce the burial ceremonies shortly.

According to information obtained this morning, Judge d'Hooghe for the past three weeks was receiving daily treatment for his teeth with Dr. E. Rosenthal, dental surgeon, at 788 Bubbling Well Road, between 5 p.m. to 6 p.m.

Visited Dentist
Last night, it is learned, Judge d'Hooghe had appeared at the dentist's office for the usual treatment and left the dentist's office at 6 p.m. and proceeded to his home when he was shot.

It is believed that the gunmen were aware of Judge d'Hooghe's habit of visiting the dentist. Both men were apparently lying in wait close to the official's home when he returned there shortly before 6.30 p.m.

As Judge d'Hooghe was just stepping out of his car, the two gunmen came up and instantly opened fire, shooting at the aged French official from almost point-blank range. Four shots were fired by the attackers, three hitting the victim's body which slumped to the ground.

Constable Gives Chase
An Annamite constable on duty nearby along Avenue Joffre heard the shooting and rushed on the scene. He attempted to follow the gunmen, but was unable to overtake them and it is believed that they finally made their escape in a waiting motorcar.

Judge d'Hooghe was immediately taken in an ambulance to Saint Marie's Hospital. He was operated on by Dr. Martin, but despite all efforts to save his life he succumbed to his wounds at 8 p.m.

Political Motive
That the slaying of Judge d'Hooghe was instigated through a political motive, was this morning felt to be most probable by officials, since it was rumored that he had advised the transfer of the Second Special District Court in the French Concession to the Nanking regime.

Judge d'Hooghe has been a resident in Shanghai for the past 15 years. He received his training at the Lille University, where he obtained a Doctor of Law degree with honors in 1895. He fought in the French army during the World War and afterward went to New York where he was a member of the French Embassy staff for several years. Later he became French Consul General in Saigon and then in 1925 came here to become President of the Mixed and Consular Courts.
pages.zh:
在沪法侨哀悼
德胡格遇刺案

两名枪手在家门口台阶上杀害知名官员；无名刺客近距离向法官开枪

昨晚傍晚，64岁的法租界公董局法律顾问爱德华·德胡格·德拉戈格里法官在其位于博塞宗路（Route de Boissezon）24号的住所门口附近遭到两名不明枪手四次射击，身受致命伤。这一残酷的暗杀事件发生后，今天本地法侨社区笼罩在庄严的悲剧气氛中。

法租界警方今晨正在加紧调查此案，因为人们强烈认为这起凶杀案与政治动机有关。然而，今晨尚未查明枪手的身份，尽管据简要描述，两人都身穿中式服装。

无家属
据悉，德胡格法官是在沪最受欢迎和最知名的法侨之一，他没有直系亲属，因为他曾结过两次婚，但两位妻子都先于他去世。他没有子女。

今晨正在筹划这位已故官员的葬礼安排，预计法国当局将很快公布葬礼仪式。

根据今晨获得的信息，德胡格法官在过去三周里，每天下午5点至6点在泡泡井路（Bubbling Well Road，即南京西路）788号接受牙科医生E.罗森塔尔（E. Rosenthal）医生的牙齿治疗。

拜访牙医
据悉，昨晚德胡格法官前往牙医诊所接受常规治疗，并于下午6点离开诊所，在回家途中遭枪击。

人们相信枪手知晓德胡格法官看牙医的习惯。当他在下午6点半前不久回到家时，这两名男子显然正埋伏在他家附近。

当德胡格法官刚从车里出来时，两名枪手走上前并立即开火，从几乎零距离向这位年迈的法国官员射击。袭击者开了四枪，其中三枪击中受害者身体，他随即瘫倒在地。

巡捕追捕
当时在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）附近执勤的一名安南籍巡捕听到枪声并冲向现场。他试图追赶枪手，但未能追上，据信他们最终乘一辆等候的汽车逃脱。

德胡格法官立即被救护车送往圣玛丽医院（Saint Marie's Hospital）。由马丁医生（Dr. Martin）为其施行手术，但尽管尽力抢救，他仍因伤势过重于晚上8点去世。

政治动机
官员们今晨认为，德胡格法官遇刺很可能是出于政治动机，因为有传言称他曾建议将法租界第二特区法院移交给南京政权。

德胡格法官在上海居住已有15年。他在里尔大学（Lille University）接受培训，并于1895年以优异成绩获得法学博士学位。他在世界大战期间曾在法国军队服役，战后前往纽约，在那里担任法国大使馆工作人员数年。后来他成为驻西贡（Saigon）的法国总领事，随后于1925年来到这里，担任混合法庭和领事法庭庭长。

pages.en:
THE LATEST MURDER

Shanghai has been profoundly shocked by the murder on Monday evening of M. E. d'Hooghe, a judge in the French Municipal Council, which was committed near his home by two Chinese. Not only is the community shocked; it is highly indignant that such a crime should have been committed, and the time has come for a little plain talking upon the subject. It is believed that there is a connection between the recent transfer of the Second District Court in the French Concession to the Nanking régime. It is stated that M. d'Hooghe played an important part in bringing about that change by reason of the advice he gave to the French authorities, and it is being freely stated that the French official was killed for motives of revenge for the part he played. Up to the present no other possible reason for the crime has been put forward, and it is believed that none can be. That being the case it is not difficult to determine who may be responsible for this dastardly outrage.

It certainly cannot be adherents of the Nanking régime for they have no reason to be other than satisfied with the transfer of the Court, and it would be the last thing to be expected of them that they would adopt such a means of demonstrating their gratitude. There is nothing to indicate that this was merely a motiveless murder committed wantonly and for no particular purpose. No suggestion has been made that M. d'Hooghe was murdered for the purpose of robbery, or because of some obscure feud against him, and the conclusion to be drawn is that he was slain by sympathizers with the Chinese National Government at Chungking. Whether they were acting upon instructions, or completely irresponsibly cannot at the moment be ascertained. It is hoped that they committed this murder entirely on their own, and it is the duty of the Chungking Government to make that plain if that is the case. Nothing will serve to clear it of suspicion than a forthright statement fully disassociating itself from the crime and condemning the murderers, for if the men were acting upon official inspiration the obloquy which would rest upon Chungking would indeed be heavy.

Let it be said quite frankly: a Government which seeks to further its own ends by criminal methods is not worthy of its name. It is defeating its main function, namely the preservation of law and order, and the vindication of justice if it is guilty of in any way inspiring, or condoning this crime. It is, therefore, necessary in the interests of Chungking that it should condemn this outrage, and, if possible, give assistance in capturing the guilty men. This journal has not hesitated to inveigh against the many useless murders which have been committed during the last few years, and its indignation is now no greater because it happens that a European has fallen before the weapons of these assassins. Did the slaying of the late Mayor Fu Siao-en prevent his office being filled by a successor? Is it to be believed that M. d'Hooghe's position with the French Municipal Council will not be filled by another official equally loyal to his duty as the murdered man was? Those, who understand the quality of courage in men, and their resolution not to be deterred from doing what they think is right, fully realize the utter stupidity of such behaviour. It accomplishes nothing, save perhaps to encourage further criminality.

It is impossible to leave this subject without paying tribute to the fine qualities of the murdered man. M. d'Hooghe was a man who throughout his residence in Shanghai has commanded the highest respect for his ability and the eminent services he rendered to the French community. During the last fourteen troublesome years he fulfilled his duty with courage and integrity. He was a shining ornament in the French legal profession, a man of great erudition and remarkable charm. As a judge he was fearless and just, and as a lawyer one whose advice was always to be greatly respected. His passing deprives the French community of a valuable public servant, and every sympathy will be felt with the French in the great loss which has thus so callously and so needlessly been inflicted upon them. For the rest, it can only be hoped that no efforts will be spared to see that these murderers are brought to justice.
pages.zh:
最新谋杀案

上海因周一晚上法租界公董局法官E.德胡格先生在家附近被两名中国人杀害而深感震惊。不仅社区感到震惊；对于发生这样的罪行，人们感到极度愤慨，现在是就此问题进行坦率讨论的时候了。人们认为，这与近期法租界第二特区法院移交给南京政权有关。据说，德胡格先生因其向法国当局提供的建议在促成这一变革中发挥了重要作用，并且有人公开表示，这位法国官员是因其所扮演的角色而被报复杀害的。到目前为止，没有提出该罪行的其他可能原因，并且相信也不可能有其他原因。既然如此，就不难确定谁可能对这一卑鄙的暴行负责。

这肯定不是南京政权的追随者所为，因为他们没有理由不对法院的移交感到满意，而且指望他们采取这种手段来表达感激之情是最不可能的。没有任何迹象表明这仅仅是一起毫无动机、肆意妄为且无特定目的的谋杀。没有人暗示德胡格先生是为了抢劫或因某种不为人知的私怨而被杀，因此得出的结论是，他是被重庆中国国民政府的同情者杀害的。目前尚无法确定他们是奉命行事还是完全不负责任地行动。希望他们是完全自作主张犯下此谋杀案，如果是这种情况，重庆政府有责任澄清这一点。没有什么比直截了当地发表声明，完全与该罪行划清界限并谴责凶手，更能消除嫌疑的了，因为如果这些人是在官方授意下行动，那么落在重庆身上的骂名将确实沉重。

坦率地说：一个试图通过犯罪手段来推进自身目标的政府是不配其名的。如果它以任何方式煽动或纵容这一罪行，它就违背了其维持法律和秩序以及伸张正义的主要职能。因此，为了重庆的利益，有必要谴责这一暴行，并在可能的情况下协助抓捕罪犯。本报毫不犹豫地谴责过去几年发生的许多无谓的谋杀案，现在之所以愤怒并未减少，仅仅是因为这次是一名欧洲人倒在这些刺客的武器之下。前市长傅筱庵（Fu Siao-en）的遇刺是否阻止了他的职位由继任者填补？难道能相信德胡格先生在法租界公董局的职位不会由另一位像死者一样忠于职守的官员来接替吗？那些了解人类勇气品质以及不被阻碍去做他们认为正确之事的决心的人，充分认识到这种行为的极端愚蠢。这除了可能鼓励进一步的犯罪行为外，一无所成。

在不向这位遇害者的优秀品质致敬的情况下，不可能结束这个话题。德胡格先生在整个上海居住期间，因其能力和为法侨社区提供的杰出服务而赢得了最高的尊重。在过去十四年的动荡岁月里，他以勇气和正直履行了自己的职责。他是法国法律界的璀璨明珠，一位学识渊博且魅力非凡的人。作为一名法官，他无畏且公正；作为一名律师，他的建议始终备受尊重。他的离世使法侨社区失去了一位宝贵的公仆，人们对法国人遭受如此冷酷且不必要的巨大损失深表同情。此外，只能希望不遗余力地确保这些凶手受到法律的制裁。

pages.en:
Local Circles Shocked by
Murder of M. d’Hooghe

Brilliant Career Brought to Untimely End ;
Funeral Arrangements

FRENCH official, legal and other circles here yesterday were
shocked by the news of the assassination on Monday of M.
Edouard d’Hooghe de la Gauguerie, legal adviser to the French
Consulate-General and French Municipal Council in Shanghai. The
opinion was expressed in some quarters that the removal of M.
d’Hooghe from public office would leave a gap difficult to fill owing
to the wide experience and local knowledge of the deceased.

Funeral services will be held for
the late M. d’Hooghe tomorrow
preceded by a requiem mass at
9 a.m. at St. Pierre’s church on
Avenue Dubail.

Just as in all previous assassina-
tions and assaults made by Chinese
gunmen on foreign officials here, the
assassins were still at large yester-
day, despite all the efforts made by
the French Police to arrest them.
Investigations, however, are being
continued and French Police officials
yesterday expressed hope that the
two Chinese would fall into their
hands in the near future.

Political Background

Opinions were also expressed that
the crime had been committed on
political grounds as M. d’Hooghe was
known to have advised the French
authorities to transfer the Chinese
courts in the French Concession to
the Nanking Regime.

The late M d’Hooghe was return-
ing home, after visiting his dentist
at about 6:30 p.m. on Monday when
the two gunmen fired several shots
just as he was alighting in front of
his home at 24 Route de Boissezon.
Several policemen were attracted by
the shots and attempted to arrest the
assassins, but they disappeared in the
darkness. The wounded official died
at Ste. Marie’s Hospital at about 8.30
p.m.

The late M. d’Hooghe was a barris-
ter-at-law and was associated with
the Bench of the Court of Appeals
of Douai, 1893-1914; was mobilized
on August 7, 1914. He was an officer
in the Ambulance Corps and served
in Flanders and was demobilized
on January 15, 1919, after being
wounded twice, was a justice of
the peace at Rabat (Morocco) 1917-
1919; President of the Tribunal of
Avesnes in 1919. President of the
Oudjda (Morocco) in 1920; Counsel-
lor of the Court of Appeals of Sai-
gon, 1922 and was transferred to the
French Consulate-General here in
1925 and was Attorney-General of
the Court of Appeals in Saigon in
1929 and was a Chevalier of the
Legion d’Honneur and holder of the
Medaille Coloniale and Med. Interal-
liee. He was president of the French
Mixed Court and upon its rendition
assumed the post he held at the
time of his death.

Deceased was a widower and had
no near relatives in Shanghai at the
time of his death. His ardent in-
terest in local welfare work has been
notable. He has made a wide circle
of friends both among the local
French and other communities here
and was one of the most popular
local French officials.

Author

He was the author of the French
work entitled “The Fruit of the
Tree” being a history of present day
civilization and religion written two
years ago and which a prominent
member of the local French com-
munity yesterday described as an
imperishable monument to the genius
and forensic eminence of the au-
thor. The work was more of a phi-
losophical treatise which in rhetoric
and style surpassed anything of the
kind written in the French language
in Shanghai for many years.

The passing of M. d’Hooghe leaves
unfinished several important tasks in-
cluding the work of the Housing
Committee of the French Concession
of which the late M. d’Hooghe was
president and who recently proposed
a new French Consular Ordinance
abolishing the “Key-Money” System
and restricting abuses in the housing
situation in the French Concession.
pages.zh:
当地各界对
德胡格先生遇刺案感到震惊

辉煌生涯戛然而止；
葬礼安排

昨日，驻沪法国官方、法律界及其他各界人士对周一法国驻上海总领事馆及法公董局法律顾问爱德华·德胡格·德拉戈格里（Edouard d’Hooghe de la Gauguerie）先生遇刺身亡的消息感到震惊。有观点认为，鉴于逝者经验丰富且深谙本地情况，德胡格先生离开公职后将留下难以填补的空缺。

已故德胡格先生的葬礼将于明日举行，上午9时先在杜拜路（Avenue Dubail）圣伯多禄堂（St. Pierre’s church）举行安魂弥撒。

正如此前所有由中国枪手针对在沪外国官员实施的刺杀和袭击案件一样，尽管法国警方全力缉捕，刺客昨日仍逍遥法外。然而，调查工作仍在继续，法国警方官员昨日表示，希望这两名中国籍嫌犯在不久的将来落网。

政治背景

亦有观点认为，此案系出于政治动机，因为众所周知，德胡格先生曾建议法国当局将法租界内的中国法院移交给南京政府。

周一傍晚约6时30分，已故德胡格先生在看完牙医后返家途中，刚在布西宗路（Route de Boissezon）24号自家门前下车时，两名枪手向他连开数枪。几名警察被枪声吸引，试图逮捕刺客，但刺客消失在夜色中。受伤的官员于当晚约8时30分在圣玛丽医院（Ste. Marie’s Hospital）去世。

已故德胡格先生是一名出庭律师，1893年至1914年间任职于杜埃（Douai）上诉法院法官席；1914年8月7日应征入伍。他在救护队担任军官，在佛兰德斯（Flanders）服役，因两次负伤，于1919年1月15日退役；1917年至1919年任拉巴特（Rabat，摩洛哥）治安法官；1919年任阿韦讷（Avesnes）法庭庭长。1920年任乌季达（Oudjda，摩洛哥）法庭庭长；1922年任西贡（Saigon）上诉法院顾问，并于1925年调任驻沪法国总领事馆；1929年任西贡上诉法院检察长；获颁荣誉军团骑士勋章（Chevalier of the Legion d’Honneur），并持有殖民奖章（Medaille Coloniale）和协约国奖章（Med. Interalliee）。他曾任会审公廨主席，在该机构移交后，出任其去世时所担任的职务。

逝者为鳏夫，去世时在沪无近亲。他对本地福利工作的热忱令人瞩目。他在本地法国人及其他社群中广结善缘，是最受欢迎的本地法国官员之一。

著作

他是法文著作《树之果》（The Fruit of the Tree）的作者，该书是一部关于现代文明与宗教的历史著作，写于两年前。昨日，本地法国社群的一位知名成员称该书是作者天才与法学卓越成就的不朽纪念碑。这部作品更像是一部哲学论著，其修辞和风格超越了多年来在上海以法语写成的任何同类作品。

德胡格先生的离世使几项重要工作未竟，包括法租界住房委员会的工作，已故德胡格先生曾任该委员会主席，他最近提出了一项新的法国领事条例草案，旨在废除“顶费”制度并限制法租界住房状况中的滥用行为。

pages.en:
Murdered

Judge Edouard d'Hooghe de la
Gauguerie, "grand old man" of the
French Municipal Council murdered
Monday, will be buried tomorrow
morning.

Burial Tomorrow
Funeral Of
D'Hooghe To
Draw City

One of the most impressive
funeral ceremonies in the his-
tory of Shanghai will take
place tomorrow morning, when
the last rites will be held at
the Lokawei Cemetery for the
late Judge Edouard d'Hooghe
de la Gauguerie, aged French
Municipal Advocate murdered
by two Chinese gunmen 6.30
p.m. Monday.

The funeral procession will start
from St. Peter's Church, 270 Avenue
Dubail, at 9 a.m. A guard of honor
will be provided by the French
Municipal Police and a contingent
of the French forces, and the police
band will be in attendance.

Present at the funeral service
will be all the high military, con-
sular, diplomatic and administrative
officials of the Settlement and the
French Concession, since M.

d'Hooghe not only occupied a high
post but was extremely popular
among all circles. Russians, to
whom he did many a service, spoke
of him as the "grand old man" of
Shanghai.

Detectives of the French
police yesterday pressed investi-
gations into the murder, amid
the growing conviction that the
63-year-old French Municipal
Advocate was shot due to his
important role in the recent
transfer of the Second Special
District Court to the Nanking
regime.

The French police said no arrests
had been made but that in-

being energetically carried out.

Wounded Twice In War

M. d'Hooghe was born at Dunkirk
on July 27, 1873 of an old family
distinguished for its lawyers and
magistrates. His legal career began
20 years later at the village of
Douai where he served in the Court
of Appeal after his admission to
the bar.

During the Great War, M.
d'Hooghe served for four years and
nine months in the French Army
where he finally became an am-
bulance officer. He was wounded
twice in battle.

Retiring again to civilian life, the
distinguished Frenchman served his
country in Saigon and later in
Shanghai as president of the con-
sular tribunal.

In 1929 he was named General
Advocate for the French Court. One
year later he became a Chevalier of
the Legion of Honor. His elevation
to president of the Chamber of the
Court of Appeal came in 1934.

Lead Rent Probe

M. d'Hooghe was married twice,
both of his wives dying before him.
He left no children.

Apart from his legal work the
French official was deeply interested
in spiritualism and philosophy. About
a year ago he wrote a book on
spiritualism, which was published
locally.

The months prior to his death
were occupied for M. d'Hooghe with
his intensive study of the rent pro-
blem here. Under his leadership,
the Housing Committee of the
F.M.C. completed an exhaustive en-
quiry into housing conditions here,
and a report urging suppression of
the key-money practice was sub-
mitted by the committee to French
Consul-General Roland J. de
Margerie.

法公董局“德高望重的长者”、法官爱德华·德胡格·德拉戈格里于周一遇害，将于明晨下葬。

明日下葬
德胡格葬礼
将轰动全城

上海历史上最隆重的葬礼之一将于明晨举行，届时将为已故法官爱德华·德胡格·德拉戈格里举行最后 rites，安葬于卢家湾公墓（Lokawei Cemetery）。这位年迈的法公董局法律顾问于周一傍晚6时30分被两名中国枪手杀害。

送葬队伍将于上午9时从杜拜路270号圣伯多禄堂出发。法国市政警察和一支法国军队分队将组成仪仗队，警乐队也将出席。

租界和法租界的所有高级军事、领事、外交和行政官员都将出席葬礼，因为德胡格先生不仅身居高位，而且在各界极受欢迎。他曾帮助过许多俄国人，他们称他为上海的“德高望重的长者”。

法国警方侦探昨日加紧调查这起谋杀案，人们越来越确信，这位63岁的法公董局法律顾问之所以遭枪击，是因为他在近期将第二特区法院移交给南京政府的过程中发挥了重要作用。

法国警方称尚未逮捕任何人，但正在积极进行谋杀案调查。

战争中两次负伤

德胡格先生于1873年7月27日出生于敦刻尔克（Dunkirk），出自一个以律师和法官闻名的古老家族。他的法律生涯始于20年后，在取得律师资格后，他在杜埃村的上诉法院任职。

大战期间，德胡格先生在法国军队服役四年九个月，最终成为救护队军官。他在战斗中两次负伤。

再次退隐平民生活后，这位杰出的法国人在西贡服务，随后在上海担任领事法庭庭长，为国效力。

1929年，他被任命为法国法院总检察官。一年后，他成为荣誉军团骑士。1934年，他晋升为上诉法院庭长。

主导租金调查

德胡格先生结过两次婚，两任妻子均先于他去世。他没有子女。

除了法律工作外，这位法国官员对唯灵论和哲学深感兴趣。大约一年前，他写了一本关于唯灵论的书，并在本地出版。

在去世前的几个月里，德胡格先生致力于深入研究本地的租金问题。在他的领导下，法公董局住房委员会完成了对本地住房状况的全面调查，委员会向法国总领事罗兰·J·德·马热里（Roland J. de Margerie）提交了一份报告，呼吁取缔顶费做法。

pages.en:
M. E. d'Hooghe
Assassinated
Near Home

Political Motive Said
Behind Foul Crime

M. E. d'Hooghe, legal adviser to the French Municipal Council, was assassinated yesterday evening outside his home, being fatally wounded by two Chinese gunmen at 6:30 p.m. He was shot down while getting out of his car on Rue de Bolssezon, the assassins escaping under cover of darkness. Occupants of nearby apartment houses heard the shooting, and the whole neighbourhood was immediately put in a panic, people running off the streets and taking cover behind buildings. It is understood that there may be a political motive behind the crime.

Shortly before 6:30 M. d'Hooghe drove up in his car to his house at 11 Rue de Bissezon. He was alighting when two Chinese, who had evidently been waiting for him, ran out from a doorway, and drew heavy revolvers. They fired four times at their helpless victim, who slumped back in the car, and half out. The men fired two more shots at the prostrate body from close range, and started to run down the street. A Chinese constable on duty at the corner of Rue de Bissezon, near Avenue Joffre was attracted by the sound of the shots, and immediately ran towards the scene of the murder. The Chinese disappeared under cover of the darkness, however, and after pursuing them for a short distance the constable gave up the chase.

Bleeding Copiously

In the meantime an ambulance was called by spectators of the murder, and M. d'Hooghe, who was bleeding copiously from several body wounds, was rushed to the St. Marie's Hospital where he died two hours later. He was operated on by Doctor Martin, but all efforts to save his life were unavailing.

M. d'Hooghe was said to have been largely instrumental in advising the transfer of the Second District Court in the French Concession, to the Nanking regime, and it therefore thought that the murder was of Chungking terrorist origin. The gunmen were dressed in foreign clothes, and appeared fairly prosperous, according to eye-witnesses. The crime was evidently well-planned in advance, since the whole thing was perfectly timed. Prior knowledge of their victim's movements must have been gained by the assassins, for it is believed that they did not appear on the scene of the murder until a short time before M. d'Hooghe returned to his home.

Although no arrests had been made by the French Police in connection with the crime up to a late hour last night it is understood that careful investigations are being made, and that it is possible the murderers will be apprehended. Immediately after the assassination a cordon was thrown round the district, careful examination for possible clues being made. The Chinese, however, must have moved away quickly, probably having a car waiting, and were well out of reach before the police could close in on them.

The chauffeur in the car with M. d'Hooghe was helpless during the shooting, which was over in a few seconds. The men were cool and deliberate in their shooting, coming quite close to their victim for the final bullets.

Tragic for Community

The death of M. d'Hooghe at the hands of assassins last night will be a heavy blow to the Shanghai community, for he was respected and honoured by members of every nation here. He performed his duties fearlessly and without prejudice during his fourteen years in the city passing through difficult times with courage and uprightness, earning universal regard. He was an erudite man, well-known for his scholarship and deep learning, not only in legal matters, but also in philosophy, in which he took great interest.

At the time of his death M. d'Hooghe was legal adviser to the French Municipal Council, having held that post since 1932. He received his training at the University of Lille, where he took the Doctor of Law degree with honours in 1895 After practising law in France for a time with conspicuous success he was mobilized in 1914, spending four years with the French army

After the war he went to New York, where he was a member of the French Embassy staff for several years. His services were rewarded when he was made French Consul at Saigon, Indo-China. In 1926 he came to Shanghai as President of the Mixed and Consular Court here. After four years in this position he resigned to take up the post of legal adviser to the French Municipal Council in 1932. He held this position until murdered yesterday. High tribute was paid to M. d'Hooghe yesterday by one of his colleagues, who said that he "was an upright and fearless man, and a sympathetic colleague to work with. He was kindly with subordinates, teaching many a great deal. I shall always remember him with respect and regard."

He was married twice, both wives dying before him. He leaves no children.

Interested in Philosophy

Apart from his legal work M. d'Hooghe was deeply interested in spiritualism and philosophy. A little more than a year ago he wrote a book on spiritualism, which was published locally. He was well-known here for his scholarship, taking a prominent part in discussions and lectures.

His unfortunate death will be regretted by colleagues and friends in many parts of the world, for he endeared himself wherever he went. As legal adviser to the F. M. C. he was extremely popular and was noted for fairness in everything he did. He always stood up for the weak and oppressed, seeing to it that justice was dealt out regardless of class or race.

He was interested in the problem of rent increases here, and shortly before his death submitted a detailed report to the French Consul-General regarding the key-money system, as worked in the Concession. He wished to abolish this system, and establish one more just. This single action is characteristic of the man, typifying his life and constant struggle against injustice.
pages.zh:
M. E. d'Hooghe
在家附近
遭暗杀

据称卑鄙罪行背后
有政治动机

法国公董局法律顾问 M. E. d'Hooghe 于昨晚在其寓所外遭暗杀，下午6时30分被两名中国枪手击中，受致命伤。他在波塞宗路（Rue de Bolssezon）下车时遭到枪击，刺客借夜色掩护逃脱。附近公寓楼的住户听到了枪声，整个街区顿时陷入恐慌，人们逃离街道，躲在建筑物后避难。据悉，这起犯罪背后可能存在政治动机。

下午6时30分前不久，d'Hooghe 先生驾车抵达其位于波塞宗路11号的住所。正当他下车时，两名显然一直在等候他的中国人从门口冲出，拔出了重型左轮手枪。他们向无助的受害者连开四枪，受害者瘫倒回车内，身体半露在车外。凶手随后近距离对着倒地的尸体又补了两枪，然后沿街逃窜。一名在靠近霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）的波塞宗路拐角处执勤的中国巡捕被枪声吸引，立即跑向谋杀现场。然而，这两名中国人在夜色掩护下消失，巡捕短距离追击后放弃了追捕。

大量出血

与此同时，谋杀案的目击者叫来了一辆救护车，身上多处伤口大量出血的 d'Hooghe 先生被紧急送往圣玛丽医院（St. Marie's Hospital），两小时后身亡。马丁医生（Doctor Martin）为他进行了手术，但所有挽救生命的努力均告无效。

据说，d'Hooghe 先生在建议将法租界第二特区法院移交给南京政权方面发挥了重要作用，因此人们认为这起谋杀案系重庆方面的恐怖分子所为。据目击者称，枪手身着西式服装，看起来相当富裕。这起犯罪显然是经过精心预谋的，因为整个过程的时间拿捏得完美无缺。刺客必定事先掌握了受害者的行踪，因为据信他们在 d'Hooghe 先生回家前不久才出现在谋杀现场。

尽管直到昨晚深夜，法国警方尚未就此案逮捕任何人，但据悉正在进行细致的调查，凶手有可能被抓获。暗杀发生后，警方立即对该地区实施了封锁，并仔细搜寻可能的线索。然而，这两名中国人必定迅速撤离，可能有一辆汽车在等候，在警方完成包围之前，他们早已远走高飞。

枪击过程仅持续了几秒钟，与 d'Hooghe 同车的司机在此期间束手无策。凶手开枪时冷静且蓄意，为了射出最后的子弹，他们甚至凑得离受害者非常近。

社区之悲剧

昨晚 d'Hooghe 先生死于刺客之手，这对上海社区来说是一个沉重的打击，因为这里各国人士都对他表示尊敬和敬重。他在上海度过的十四年中，无畏且公正地履行职责，以勇气和正直度过艰难时期，赢得了普遍的尊重。他是一位博学之士，不仅在法律事务上，而且在他深感兴趣的哲学领域，都以其学识和深厚的造诣而闻名。

d'Hooghe 先生去世时担任法国公董局法律顾问，自1932年起一直担任该职。他在里尔大学（University of Lille）接受教育，于1895年以优异成绩获得法学博士学位。在法国从事律师工作并取得显著成功后，他于1914年被征召入伍，在法国军队服役四年。

战后他前往纽约，在那里担任法国大使馆工作人员数年。因其服务有功，他被任命为印度支那西贡的法国领事。1926年，他来到上海，担任这里的混合法庭及领事法庭庭长。在该职位任职四年后，他辞职并于1932年就任法国公董局法律顾问。他一直担任此职直至昨日遇害。昨天，他的一位同事对 d'Hooghe 先生给予了高度评价，称他“是一位正直无畏的人，也是一位令人同情的好共事者。他对下属和蔼可亲，教导了许多人。我将永远怀着敬意和怀念铭记他。”

他结过两次婚，两位妻子均先于他去世。他没有留下子女。

对哲学感兴趣

除了法律工作外，d'Hooghe 先生还对灵学和哲学深感兴趣。一年多前，他写了一本关于灵学的书，并在本地出版。他在这里以学识渊博而闻名，积极参与讨论和讲座。

他在世界各地的同事和朋友都将对他的不幸去世感到惋惜，因为无论走到哪里，他都深受人们喜爱。作为法国公董局（F. M. C.）的法律顾问，他极受欢迎，并以行事公平著称。他总是为弱者和受压迫者挺身而出，确保不论阶级或种族，都能得到公正的对待。

他关注本地的房租上涨问题，并在去世前不久就法租界实行的顶费制度向法国总领事提交了一份详细报告。他希望废除这一制度，建立一个更公平的制度。这单一举动便体现了这个人的特点，典型地反映了他的一生以及他与不公正现象进行的持续斗争。

Gunmen Slay
High Official

M. Edouard D'Hooghe de
la Gauguerie, legal adviser
and avocat of the French
Municipal Council and in-
terim director of the French
Concession administration,
was fatally shot at 6.30
o'clock yesterday evening by
two Chinese gunmen in front
of his home, 24 Route de
Boissezon.

M. D Hooghe was return-
ing home from his offices at
the French Consulate-Gen-
eral when the shooting oc-
curred. Before the chauffeur
could open the door for his
master, the murderers thrust
their pistols into the car and
fired four shots into their
victim's chest and back.

An immediate operation was per-
formed at St. Marie's Hospital, but
the 62-year-old Frenchtown official
failed to rally. A younger man
might have survived, but M.
D'Hooghe was already suffering
from a weak heart, and he was
pronounced dead at 7.45 p.m.

As the legal adviser to the
French Consulate-General, he
negotiated the recent transfer
of the Second Special District
Court to the Nanking Govern-
ment.

M. D'Hooghe, a bachelor who
lived alone, had a long and dis-
tinguished career here. He first
came to Shanghai in 1926 and
rose rapidly in public affairs.
As an official of the F.M.C. he
made many friends and was
generally popular with his asso-
ciates.

The shooting of the French Con-
cession leader is the first major
assassination of a foreigner in
China since Putnam Weale (B.
Lennox Simpson) was shot to death

枪手杀害
公董局
高官

爱德华·德胡格·德·拉戈格里（Edouard D'Hooghe de la Gauguerie）先生，法国公董局法律顾问及出庭律师，兼法租界公署代理局长，于昨晚6时30分在其位于波塞宗路24号的寓所前，被两名中国枪手开枪击中，受致命伤。

德胡格先生当时正从法国总领事馆办公室返回家中，枪击事件随即发生。在司机能为其主人打开车门之前，凶手将手枪伸进车内，向受害者的胸部和背部开了四枪。

圣玛丽医院立即进行了手术，但这位62岁的法租界官员未能恢复生机。若是年轻些的人或许能幸存，但德胡格先生已患有心脏衰弱，于晚上7时45分被宣告死亡。

作为法国总领事馆的法律顾问，他促成了近期第二特区法院向南京政府的移交。

德胡格先生是单身，独自居住，在上海有着漫长而杰出的职业生涯。他于1926年初次来到上海，在公共事务中迅速崛起。作为法国公董局（F.M.C.）的官员，他结交了许多朋友，在同僚中普遍受欢迎。

这位法租界领袖遭枪击，是自十多年前普特南·韦尔（Putnam Weale，即 B. Lennox Simpson）在天津因海关管理纠纷被枪杀以来，中国发生的第一起针对外国人的重大暗杀事件。

pages.en:
Judge D’Hooghe
Is Assassinated
Near Own Home

French Municipal Advocate Shot In Back By Two
Chinese Gunmen; Dies In Hospital; Came
Here As Assessor To Old Mixed Court

**〔此处转录不清〕** 63-year-old
French Municipal Advocate, was shot and mortally wounded
by two Chinese gunmen at 6.30 p.m. yesterday just as he stepped
from his motor car outside his home at 24 Route de Boissezon.
Despite the fact that officers of the French Police, attracted by
the sound of two shots, rushed to the scene immediately, the
assassins managed to make good their escape.

The news of the attempt on the life of the popular jurist spread like wildfire through the local French community and numerous enquiries as to his condition were made at Ste. Marie Hospital, where he was taken. The elderly judge succumbed to his wounds shortly after 8 o'clock last night.

Motive Sought

The judge was not known to have any personal enemies and authorities were at a loss to find a motive for the brutal killing last night. It was suggested, however, that in his capacity of Municipal Advocate

of the French Municipal Council Judge D'Hooghe was directly connected with the recent transfer of the Second Special District Court to the jurisdiction of the Nanking Regime and that perhaps this had led to his end.

The judge's chauffeur was the only witness to the fatal shooting. He heard the sound of the shots saw his master fall to the pavement and then noticed two Chinese fleeing in the opposite direction. When the police arrived on the scene, there was no trace of the gunmen.

Served In Indo-China

Judge D'Hooghe, who was very popular in Shanghai, started his career as a lawyer in France. Later he was sent by his government to Indo-China and was attached to the magistrate's office, rising to the rank of Avocat-General (Chief Prosecutor).

About fifteen years ago he was transferred to Shanghai as Assessor to the former Chinese Mixed Court. When in July, 1931, the Mixed Court was handed over to the Chinese Government, he was appointed Police Advocate, later accepting the post of Municipal Advocate.

The late judge was a widower, his wife having died in Shanghai several years ago. He lived a retired life. Only sometimes taking an active part in charitable work.

JUDGE D’HOOGHE

德胡格法官
在自家附近
遭暗杀

法国公董局辩护律师被两名中国枪手从背后射击；在医院身亡；曾作为旧混合法庭会审官来沪

**〔此处转录不清〕** 这位63岁的法国公董局辩护律师，于昨日下午6时30分在其位于波塞宗路24号的寓所外刚从汽车下来时，被两名中国枪手枪击并受致命伤。尽管法国警察官员被两声枪响吸引，立即赶赴现场，但刺客仍成功逃脱。

这位受人爱戴的法学家遇刺的消息在当地法国社区中迅速传开，许多人向他被送去的圣玛丽医院（Ste. Marie Hospital）询问其状况。这位年迈的法官于昨晚8点后不久因伤重不治。

寻找动机

据知，这位法官没有任何个人仇敌，当局对昨晚这起残忍杀戮的动机感到困惑。然而，有人指出，鉴于德胡格法官作为法国公董局辩护律师的身份，他直接参与了近期将第二特区法院移交给南京政权管辖的事宜，这或许导致了他的死亡。

法官的司机是这起致命枪击案的唯一目击者。他听到枪声，看到主人倒在人行道上，随后注意到两名中国人向相反方向逃窜。当警察到达现场时，已不见枪手的踪影。

曾在印度支那任职

德胡格法官在上海非常受欢迎，他的职业生涯始于在法国担任律师。后来，他被政府派往印度支那，附属于 magistrate's office（推事厅/检察官办公室），晋升至 Avocat-General（首席检察官）一职。

大约十五年前，他被调往上海，担任前中国混合法庭的会审官。1931年7月，混合法庭移交给中国政府时，他被任命为警务处辩护律师，随后接受了公董局辩护律师的职位。

已故法官是一位鳏夫，其妻子几年前在上海去世。他过着隐居的生活，偶尔积极参与慈善工作。

德胡格法官

December 17, 1940. Morning Translation.

Cheng Yien Pao, Chinese-American Daily News, Sin Wan Pao,
Shun Poo, National Herald :-

ASSASSINATION OF JUDGE D'HOCGHE, FRENCH MUNICIPAL ADVOCATE

At 7.15 p.m. yesterday, Judge D'Hooghe,
French Municipal Advocate, was fatally shot on Route de
Boissezon in the French Concession.
Judge D'Hooghe and his family lived in Room 34
in a foreign apartment house at No. 24 Route de Boissezon.
At 8 a.m. every day, he went to his office in the French
Municipal Council and returned to his apartment at about
6 p.m. in his private motor car (licence No. 641).
After returning to his apartment from his
office yesterday afternoon, Judge D'Hooghe left his room
and went downstairs at 7.15 p.m. intending to go to a
dinner party. As he approached his private motor car
which was parked in front of the apartment, two men
suddenly appeared from the roadside and fired five or six
shots; two bullets struck him in the head and one took
effect in the waist. Judge D'Hooghe collapsed. Seeing
that they had attained their aim, the gunmen made good
their escape.
Upon receipt of a report, the French Police
sent out a large party of detectives and policemen in
Police vans and a search was made for the gunmen, but
without success. Judge D'Hooghe was immediately removed
to St. Marie Hospital. At 8 p.m. an operation was
performed, but due to his advanced age, the Judge succumbed
to his serious wounds at 8.35 p.m.
Judge D'Hooghe was 65 years of age at the time
of his death. He came to China a number of years ago,
and was once Presiding Judge in the now defunct Mixed
Court in the French Concession. He had held his present
position for 14 years.
The French Police are investigating the
cause of the assassination.

《诚言报》、《中美日报》、《新晚报》、
《申报》、《国民新闻报》：

法国公董局辩护律师德胡格法官遇刺案

昨晚7时15分，法国公董局辩护律师德胡格法官在法租界波塞宗路遭枪击身亡。
德胡格法官及其家人居住在波塞宗路24号的一栋外籍公寓楼的34室。
他每天早上8点前往法国公董局的办公室，并于下午6点左右乘坐私人汽车（牌照号641）返回公寓。
昨天下午从办公室回到公寓后，德胡格法官于晚上7时15分离开房间下楼，打算去参加一个晚宴。当他走向停在公寓前的私人汽车时，两名男子突然从路边出现，开了五六枪；两颗子弹击中他的头部，一颗击中腰部。德胡格法官倒地。枪手见目的已达，便迅速逃脱。
接到报告后，法国警方派出大批侦探和警察，乘坐警车出动搜捕枪手，但未获成功。德胡格法官被立即送往圣玛丽医院。晚上8点进行了手术，但由于年事已高，法官于晚上8时35分因重伤不治身亡。
德胡格法官去世时享年65岁。他于数年前来到中国，曾担任现已撤销的法租界混合法庭的主审法官。他担任现职已有14年。
法国警方正在调查暗杀原因。

DEMOLITION OF CHINESE HOUSES IN THE WESTERN DISTRICT
FOR PURPOSE OF ROAD CONSTRUCTION

Yesterday morning, the Japanese were busy constructing a new road, 40 feet wide, in the Western District to link that part of Great Western Road, where the Japanese gendarme Sasage was shot two weeks ago, with Yu Yuen Road. A high wooden door, painted white, has been erected at the entrance to New Great Western Road, where, it is believed, Japanese soldiers and mercenary policemen will be permanently stationed on guard.

The new road will be named "Sasage Road". This road will connect with another new road which starts from the spot on Jessfield Road where Corporal S. Sato was assassinated two months ago. The latter road will be named "Sato Road". It will start from the Japanese Gendarmes Headquarters at 94 Jessfield Road and terminate on Yu Yuen Road between Tifeng Road and Edinburgh Road and encircle Kinnear Road. Many Chinese houses on Jessfield Road have been pulled down for the construction of "Sato Road". Most of the residents removed after the shooting of the Japanese gendarme, but about 4,000 Chinese suffered a blockade for a period of five days. It is believed that the Japanese will build a road to connect Great Western Road with Yu Yuen Road.

Yesterday the barbed wire barricades in front of the Peh Loh Emporium (百樂商場) on Yu Yuen Road were still in position, while the number of armed Japanese soldiers have increased from two to three with about seven unarmed mercenary policemen. A passage has been opened by the Japanese at the intersection of Bubbling Well and Foo Ping Roads for vehicles and pedestrians. Several mercenary policemen and two armed Japanese soldiers are on guard.

New China Daily News :-

ASSASSINATION IN THE FRENCH CONCESSION

In connection with the assassination that took place in the French Concession last night, it is learned that the late Mr. D'Hooghe had been in the employ of the French Municipal Council for about 17 years. He was clever and intelligent and was high in the confidence of the authorities. It was he who acted as an intermediary during and after the taking over of the Shanghai Second Special District Court and the Third Branch Kiangsu High Court by the Nanking Government. During the process of transfer, D'Hooghe acted as a representative of the French Municipal Council in the signing of legal documents.
Besides acting as a legal advisor to the French Municipal Council, he also held the posts of Chief of the Legal Advisory Office of the Shanghai Second Special District Court following the resignation of the Municipal Advocates of the French Police and functioned as a Municipal Advocate of the French Police in handling cases in Court. He was not only an expert lawyer but was much devoted to his work; in short, he was a genius.

P. T. O.

《新华日报》：-

法租界刺杀案

关于昨晚发生在法租界的刺杀案，据悉死者德胡格（D'Hooghe）先生受雇于公董局约17年。他聪明机智，深获当局信任。在南京政府接管上海第二特区法院和江苏高等法院第三分院期间及之后，正是他担任中间人。在移交过程中，德胡格作为公董局代表签署了法律文件。
除了担任公董局法律顾问外，他在法国警务处市政律师辞职后，还兼任上海第二特区法院法律咨询处处长一职，并在法庭处理案件时履行法国警务处市政律师的职能。他不仅是一位专家律师，而且对工作极为投入；简言之，他是一位天才。

THE CHINESE COURTS IN THE FRENCH CONCESSION OF SHANGHAI

Police Deny Knowledge
Arrest Of FMP
Lawyers Asked
By Chungking

French Police officials yesterday claimed ignorance of the cabled report from Chungking that the Chinese National Government issued warrants for the arrest of three lawyers employed as Municipal Advocates at the Second Special District Court and the Kiangsu High Court (Third Branch) which were ceded to the Nanking regime by the French authorities last month.

The three lawyers wanted by the National Government — Hsu Wi-fong, Cheng Hai-sung and Mah Ping-suun—continued their work as prosecutors for the French Police yesterday. It will be recalled that they were hired to take the place of the four Municipal Advocates who quit their jobs after the court transfer.

The four former Municipal Advocates—Koo Siu-shu, Yao Zao-dee, Fei Zi-tseng and Yuan Chia-wan—received a decree of merit from the National Government praising their patriotic stand.

The Second Branch Kiangsu High Court in the Settlement was also instructed by the National Government to publish a complete list of members of the Shanghai Bar Association. Should any member of the Association be discovered to have attended the two Concession courts, they would be charged with treason and their membership would be automatically cancelled, according to the cabled report from Chungking.

November 28, 1940.

MAINICHI :-

MEMBERS OF SHANGHAI BAR ASSOCIATION IN DILEMMA

On November 8, the Second Special District Court and the Kiangsu High Court were taken over by the Judicial Department of the Nanking Government with the complete understanding of the French authorities.
The Chungking Government lodged a protest with Mr. Cosme, French Ambassador to China, against the handing over of the Courts and at the same time, issued an order to the Shanghai Bar Association prohibiting the attendance of its members at the two Courts.
The Shanghai Bar Association has some 1,500 members, most of whom depend for a living upon their practice in the First or the Second Special District Court. Therefore; the order from the Chungking Government prohibiting lawyers from attending the Courts of the Nanking Government is tantamount to an order removing them from their profession.
It is stated that the Executive Committee of the Shanghai Bar Association will hold a meeting at the Pootung Commercial Savings Bank at No. 284, Avenue Edward VII on November 28 to decide upon the attitude to be adopted by the Association.
The Shanghai Bar Association has accepted the order of the Chungking Government, yet it is going to hold a committee meeting to discuss a final decision over the Court issue. This action on the part of the Association clearly shows that the members of the Association are in a dilemma as to whether to face the danger of their lives being threatened by the Chungking terrorists or to remain out of work.
The decision of the Committee meeting is being awaited with much interest.

1940年11月28日。

《每日新闻》：-

上海律师公会会员陷入困境

11月8日，第二特区法院和江苏高等法院在法国当局的完全谅解下，被南京政府司法部接管。
重庆政府向法国驻华大使高思默（Cosme）先生提出抗议，反对移交法院，同时向上海律师公会发布命令，禁止其会员出席这两个法院。
上海律师公会拥有约1,500名会员，其中大多数人依靠在第一或第二特区法院的执业为生。因此，重庆政府禁止律师出席南京政府法院的命令，等同于剥夺其职业的命令。
据悉，上海律师公会执行委员会将于11月28日在爱多亚路284号浦东商业储蓄银行举行会议，决定公会应采取的态度。
上海律师公会已接受重庆政府的命令，但仍将召开委员会会议，就法院问题讨论最终决定。公会的这一举动清楚地表明，会员们正陷入两难境地：是面临被重庆恐怖分子威胁生命的危险，还是失业。
人们正怀着极大的兴趣等待委员会会议的决定。

November 28, 1940. Morning Translation.

Chinese-American Daily News and National Herald :-

PROCEEDINGS OF THE SHANGHAI BAR ASSOCIATION ABANDONED

The Shanghai Bar Association had issued
a notice announcing that a meeting of the Standing
Committee would be convened on November 27. Upon receipt
of this notice, the majority of the members of the committee
expressed the view that it is their natural duty to
observe the laws and orders promulgated by the Chungking
Government which had already issued an order suspending
the functions of the two Courts in the French Concession
of Shanghai. Therefore, there is no necessity for the
Association to hold any meeting to discuss the situation
because members cannot practise in the Courts in the
French Concession.
On this account no meeting was held on
November 27.

（批：Ordered to file

《中美日报》和《国民新闻》：-

上海律师公会程序中止

上海律师公会曾发出通知，宣布将于11月27日召开常务委员会会议。收到此通知后，大多数委员表示，遵守已经发布暂停上海法租界内两个法院职能命令的重庆政府所颁布的法律和命令，是他们的自然职责。因此，公会没有必要举行任何会议来讨论局势，因为会员不能在法租界的法院执业。
因此，11月27日未举行会议。

SECRET
May 15 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
Shanghai First Special District Court No. S B. D. 8293 (C)
Nanking Authorities plan to seize. Date 16-5-41

Information has been received from a usually
reliable source to the effect that in view of the
recent success which attained the efforts of the
Special Service Group in throwing the local financial
market into a chaotic state following the bombing on
March 24 of the local branches of the Chungking
Government Banks and in nominating a number of
Pro-Wang Ching Wei elements as Chinese Councillors of
the S.M.C. consequent upon the abduction of Mr. L.T.
Yuan on April 15, 1941, the Nanking Authorities have
now decided to effect seizure of the Shanghai First
Special District Court with the aid of the Special
Service Group by the following means :-
1) Assassination or armed kidnapping of those judges
of the court who entertain strong anti-Wang Ching
Wei sentiments with a view to creating a reign of
terror, thereby creating an impression that those
who continue to be stubborn in their attitude will
become victims.
2) Buying over of those judges who are not anti-Wang
Ching Wei.
3) Effecting a change in the status of the court
through the efforts of renegade judges, thus
avoiding the use of force.

In the event of failure to take over the court
through diplomatic channels or by bringing political
influence to bear upon those concerned, the Wang
Ching Wei Government will, it is reported, utilize
the Special Service Group to bring about a change
of the status quo of the tribunal in the same manner
as the Shanghai Second Special District Court in
French Concession on November 8, 1940.

南京当局计划夺取。日期 1941年5月16日

从通常可靠的消息来源获悉，鉴于特务组在3月24日轰炸重庆政府银行本地分行后成功扰乱当地金融市场，以及在1941年4月15日袁履登（L.T. Yuan）先生被绑架后提名多名亲汪精卫分子担任工部局华董方面取得的近期成功，南京当局现在决定通过以下手段，在特务组的协助下夺取上海第一特区法院：-
1) 暗杀或武装绑架那些持有强烈反汪精卫情绪的法官，旨在制造恐怖统治，从而造成一种印象，即那些态度顽固的人将成为受害者。
2) 收买那些不反汪精卫的法官。
3) 通过叛变法官的努力改变法院的地位，从而避免使用武力。

据报道，如果未能通过外交渠道或通过对相关人员施加政治影响来接管法院，汪精卫政府将利用特务组，以1940年11月8日法租界上海第二特区法院同样的方式，改变该法庭的现状。

Information regarding Chinese Courts in the Settlement(s).

Det. Inspector McCahey          Officer I/c District. C.I.

Sir,

    At 5 p.m. March 7, 1941, Chief Inspector West,
Supt. Yao Chia Zeu and the undersigned interviewed, by
appointment Judges Chow and Nyi of the Civil Court at
870 Weihaiwei Road regarding information received by
them.

    Information of a reasonably reliable nature states
that within the next few days or at least the near
future the Nanking Regime authorities will attempt to
take by force the three Courts, i.e. two on Weihaiwei
Road and the Criminal Court on North Chekiang Road.

    Judge Chow believes this information all the more
reliable because similar information was to hand prior
to the bombing incident of February 2, 1941 and the
kidnapping of Chief Judge, Dr. Hsu in the French
Concession on evening of March 5th. Further because
of the approach of the Anniversary of death of Dr. Sun
Yat Sen on March 12th.

    In view of these facts, Judge Chow requests
adequate police protection be provided. He also asked
if it is possible to have U.S. Marines posted at the
Weihaiwei Road Court houses or at least patrols in the
vicinity until after the aforesaid anniversary date.

    Judge Chow intimated that the Court was prepared
to provide billets for a sufficiently strong guard of
the R.A.D., S.M.Police.

    Judge Chow informed his interviewers that a
telegram had been received from the Judicial Yuan,

Date December 16, 1940

Subject Supreme Court of China (Chungking) - Files.

Made by D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

〔左侧边栏文字及印章模糊不清〕

Some weeks ago, the assistance of the
French Police was solicited on behalf of the M.A.,
with a view to securing certain Supreme Court
(Chungking) files, which had been left behind by
the Supreme Court judges, when the Nanking
Authorities took over control of the Courts in the
French Concession. Indirect approach was made
by the French Police to the new authorities and
it was at first thought that the efforts of the
French Police would be successful. However, a
stalemate was reached in the negotiations recently,
when the individual approached, intimated that
he would have to refer the matter to Nanking,
with the result that the French Police withdrew
from the negotiations. It would therefore appear
that nothing further can be done in the matter.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMANDER'S OFFICE 16 DEC. 1940）

A. C. (Special Branch). D. S. I.

MEMORANDUM

The Branch Supreme Court at Shanghai was dealing
with cases, civil and criminal, of third trial occurring
in the first and second special areas and has been
established for about three years in the Kiangsu High
Court, Third Branch, in the French Concession since
February 1938.

On November 2, 1940 Mr. E. d'Hooghe, Legal Adviser,
under instructions from the French Consul General inti-
mated to President Yang Bang of the Third Branch High
Court that the Nanking regime was soon to take over the
Courts in the French Concession. This Branch Supreme
Court accordingly made preparations to evacuate from
the French Concession, but the detectives and police-
men originally posted by the French Police in the Third
Branch High Court prevented it from moving things out.
On the 5th, Deputy Commissioner of French Police Leblanc
called on the Chief Judge of this Branch Supreme Court
and requested that neither files nor any other articles
be moved out. Thus all the files which this Branch
Supreme Court received from the Second and Third Branch
High Courts are left in the Third Branch High Court
and could not be removed.

On the 8th, there was a change of status in the
Courts of the French Concession. On the 10th, attempt
was made by this Branch Supreme Court to remove files.
The files belonging to the Third Branch High Court were left
untouched as only the Second Branch High Court files

备忘录

上海分院最高法院审理的是在第一和第二特区发生的一审和二审后的三审案件，自1938年2月以来，该法院已在法租界的江苏省高等法院第三分院设立约三年。

1940年11月2日，法律顾问E. d'Hooghe先生奉法国总领事指示，向江苏省高等法院第三分院院长杨邦（Yang Bang）通报，南京政权即将接管法租界内的法院。因此，该分院最高法院着手准备从法租界撤离，但最初由法国警方部署在江苏省高等法院第三分院的侦探和警察阻止其搬出物品。5日，法国警务副总监勒布朗（Leblanc）拜访了该分院最高法院的首席法官，要求不得搬出任何档案或其他物品。因此，该分院最高法院从江苏省高等法院第二和第三分院接收的所有档案均留存在江苏省高等法院第三分院，无法移出。

8日，法租界法院的地位发生变化。10日，该分院最高法院试图移出档案。属于江苏省高等法院第三分院的档案未受触动，因为只有涉及民事和刑事案件的江苏省高等法院第二分院档案

At 10.30 a.m., November 8, Mr. Zhao Van Sien
( 赵 Van Sien ), formerly Chief Procurator and newly appointed

the Ministry of Justice of the Nanking Government, and
Mr. Lieu Zao Foh ( 刘 肇 佛 ), newly appointed Chief

arrived at the office of President Yang Fang ( 杨 芳 )

Yang at first politely refused their request for the
handing over. However, in view of the indifferent

withheld assistance to President Yang, but assisted the
new Nanking appointees, he finally acceded to the
request at 11.00 a.m., same day. The handing over
was completed at 12 noon.

formerly Chief Procurator of the Shanghai 2nd Special
Area District Court, and newly appointed President of the
Court, in the company of a retinue of nine Chinese and
a party of six Japanese in plain clothes, arrived at
the office of the Shanghai 2nd Special Area District
Court, Route Stanislas Chevalier, for the purpose of
effecting the taking over. The handing over was
completed at 3.40 p.m., the same day by Mr. Zung Meu Lian
( 陈 梦 咸 ), until now President of the Court.

November 10, 1940. Morning Translation.

Chinese-American Daily News published the following
editorial on Nov. 9:

THE SHANGHAI SECOND SPECIAL DISTRICT COURTS FORCIBLY
OCCUPIED BY JAPANESE

The Third Branch of the Kiangsu High Court and
the Shanghai Second Special District Court in the French
Concession were established on the basis of an agreement
regarding the creation of Chinese Courts in the French
Concession of Shanghai. Article 2 of this Agreement
states that the Chinese Government should form, according
to the Chinese Codes and Regulations, a District Court
and a High Court in the French Concession of Shanghai.
Since both the Chinese and French Governments had consented
to the formation of the two Courts and signed the agreement,
the two governments had to observe their obligations and
protect the two Courts.

In our editorial of November 5 we clearly pointed
out that it was hoped that the authorities of the French
Concession would express their proper stand and uphold
this sacred agreement. Although the strength of the
Police and military forces in the French Concession in the
present situation is no match for the Japanese, yet they
should make some show of resistance in order to prove their
determination to uphold the agreement should the Japanese
send men to occupy the two Courts. The authorities of
the French Concession failed to do this.

FILE
According to information secured yesterday,
when the Japanese sent men to occupy the Third Branch of
the Kiangsu High Court, the armoured car No.32, ten Annamite
soldiers and policemen of the French Police on guard outside
the Court did not stop the plain clothes Japanese from
entering the Court. Afterwards, the authorities of the
Third Branch of the Kiangsu High Court, upon seeing the
sudden appearance of the plain clothes Japanese, informed
the French Police by telephone asking for protection, but
the French Police did not give any reply. This shows
that the French Police had failed to carry out their duty.
Furthermore, the authorities of the French Police had
requested the Court not to hold sessions yesterday.
M. d'Hooghe, Judicial Counsellor of the French Municipal
Council, went to the Court before the arrival of the plain
clothes Japanese. We have no desire to reproach the
authorities of the French Concession, but these facts cannot
but reveal that the Concession authorities have not fulfilled
their obligations. It may be said that the Concession
authorities were intimidated by force. The Japanese
cannot escape the stigma of having violated the French
Concession and forcibly seized the judicial organs. The
fact remains that the French Concession had failed to
maintain the agreement and the French Police had failed
to protect the lawful organizations in the French
Concession.

A spokesman of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
of the Chungking Government will lodge protests with the
French party and will order the two Courts to suspend
sessions for the time being. The Ministry declares
that any organs replacing the Chinese Courts in the French
Concession are illegal, and their decisions will not be
valid. The responsibility must be borne by the French.
It is a pity that after so many years, Sino-French relations
should have been dealt such a blow.

《中美日报》于11月9日发表如下社论：

日军强行占领上海第二特区法院

江苏高等法院第三分院及上海第二特区法院设于法租界，其设立依据为关于在法租界设立中国法院之协定。该协定第二条规定，中国政府应依照中国法律法规，在法租界设立地方法院及高等法院。既然中法两国政府均同意设立此两法院并签署协定，两国政府即有义务遵守约定并保护此两法院。

我们在11月5日的社论中明确指出，希望法租界当局能表明其正当立场，维护这一神圣协定。尽管在目前形势下，法租界的警力和军力无法与日军抗衡，但若日军派人占领此两法院，法方仍应做出某种抵抗姿态，以证明其维护协定的决心。然而，法租界当局未能做到这一点。

档案
据昨日获得的消息，当日军派人占领江苏高等法院第三分院时，停在法院外警戒的第32号装甲车、十名安南籍士兵及法国巡捕，并未阻止便衣日本人进入法院。随后，江苏高等法院第三分院当局见便衣日本人突然出现，通过电话通知法国巡捕请求保护，但法国巡捕未予任何答复。这表明法国巡捕未能履行职责。此外，法国巡捕当局曾要求法院昨日停止开庭。法国公董局司法顾问杜赫先生（M. d'Hooghe）在便衣日本人到达之前曾前往法院。我们无意指责法租界当局，但这些事实无不显示租界当局未履行其义务。可以说，租界当局是受武力胁迫。日本难逃侵犯法租界并强行夺取司法机关的恶名。事实依然是，法租界未能维持协定，法国巡捕未能保护法租界内的合法机构。

重庆政府外交部发言人将向法方提出抗议，并命令两法院暂时停止开庭。该部声明，任何取代法租界内中国法院的机构均为非法，其裁决无效。责任必须由法方承担。令人遗憾的是，中法关系历经多年竟遭受如此打击。

Yuan Chen Sz (袁陳氏), age 29, native of Shanghai, and they
have a son named Yuan Fu-sung (袁福生), age 3. He employs two
maid-servants, one of whom is named Tsai Voong (蔡鳳).
At 10.40 a.m. yesterday, whilst Yuan Hsien-kung was
asleep, three men, one in black jacket and the other two in
Chinese clothing, called at Yuan's home bringing with them two
hens and two bottles of brandy as presents. The maid-servant
opened the door to them but as they had gained admittance, one
of them produced a pistol, intimidated the two maid-servants
and held them in a room. The other two men then went upstairs
to Yuan's room where he was fast asleep. One of the men struck
Yuan in the head with an axe, delivering two cuts in the head
and four in the neck, causing profuse bleeding. The desperadoes
made good their escape, leaving the axe on Yuan's bed.
Yuan's wife made a report to the Police Station
concerned after the desperadoes had left. When the Police
arrived at the scene, Yuan had already expired. At 3 p.m. the
body was removed to the Chinese Red Cross Hospital. An
investigation is being conducted by the Police into the motive
of the crime.

FRENCH CONCESSION COURT OFFICIALS REFUSING TO ATTEND OFFICE

Confusion reigned in the two Chinese Courts in the
French Concession following their illegal seizure on November 8,
because the majority of the judges, procurators and staff of
these two tribunals are refusing to accept office under the
jurisdiction of the Nanking regime. Thus the Courts are unable
to function. Strange flags have been hoisted and red-coloured
proclamations have been put up.
According to information from reliable sources,
hereafter all criminal cases will be prosecuted by French
police officers of the French Police. The four Chinese
Municipal Advocates of the French Police, namely Messrs. Koo
Siu-hsien (顧孝先), Tsi Zih-tseng (齊子增), Pao Shao-dee
(鮑少) and Yuan Chia-huang (袁家煌), who had hitherto
handled the prosecutions on behalf of the administrative
authorities, will not appear and it is reported that
they will resign from their posts.
Yesterday morning Mr. Chang Min-sung (張民生),
a son of Mr. Chang Tsu-peng (張祖彭), who has been appointed
by the Nanking regime, without his consent, as Presiding Judge
of the Civil Division of the Shanghai Second Special District
Court, told his friends that he had already rejected the
appointment.
It is now learned that the Shanghai Bar Association
has removed from the French Concession to the International
Settlement.

The sacrifice of the French is not limited to the French Concession in Shanghai only.

If the Chungking Government should decide on retaliation, then it is possible that all her interests in China will be lost to France. The policy of toleration adopted by the French will sound the death knell in the Far East.

日本人接管法租界法院

接管法租界两所法院的主要人物是几名身穿便服的日本人，以及一些乘坐日本军车的雇员。

在他们到达江苏高等法院第三分院之前，法国公董局司法顾问 d'Hooghe 先生（音译）几天前曾去过那里，他说了一些引起极大不满的话。

当日本人到达法院时，警车、武装弹药兵（原文不清，疑为“日本士兵”之误）和巡捕在那里执勤，并在法院附近采取了预防措施。所有交通中断，行人受到搜查。局势一度危急。法租界当局曾宣布不再保护法院；因此，当天采取的预防措施并非为了保护法院。

陪同日本人的是法院雇员，据说他们已被任命为法院院长、首席检察官或民事庭庭长等职。

法院被日本人强行接管，但法租界当局未作抵抗，反而采取了友好态度。法院雇员是这两所法院的原班人员。

法租界当局采取的态度最令人失望。如果这是由于维希政府的命令，法租界当局虽不能违抗，但他们本应将上海的特殊情况提请维希政府注意，而不应如此粗暴地处理此事。如果法租界当局的行动意在向日本人投降，那么法租界当局可能未能仔细考虑自身的利益。此后，法租界的局势将变得复杂，法国警察将受他人控制。法院将不再是租界内和平与秩序的维护者。这是倒退运动的开始。如果法租界当局的行动是由于维希政府的命令，那么第二出“印度支那”戏码正在重演。在印度支那问题上，维希政府放弃了印度支那；在地方法院问题上，它正在放弃法租界。法国的牺牲不仅限于上海法租界。

重庆政府不会对法国的行动保持沉默。如果重庆政府决定报复，那么法国在中国的所有利益都可能丧失。法国采取的容忍政策将在远东敲响丧钟。

法院现有雇员已获重新任命。这暴露了法院的软弱。关于接管法院的问题早已有人谈论，公众钦佩那些公正忠诚的法官。现在危害法院的“蛀虫”正是它们自己的“蛀虫”。虽然法租界的法院现已不复存在，但其他法院仍然存在，我们希望它们在受到他人压迫时能紧密团结并进行抵抗。它们不应逃避责任。

上海市民不应气馁。有能力者应撤往内地；无能力者应为即将到来的大风暴做好准备。在法院问题上，我们不必过于在意，因为政府会考虑此事，但与法院有密切关系的人应表现出他们对正义的热爱。

Cheng Yien Pao, Chinese-American Daily News, National Herald,
